comments.content: The top-level `web` block is not part of `OrchestratorConfig`, and the web monitoring server is configured only from CLI flags (`--web`, `--web-port`, `--web-bind`) when starting TUI/run. Because serde ignores unknown fields by default, these settings are silently ignored, so the checked-in port/bind/refresh interval do not affect cflx behavior.
comments.thinking: OrchestratorConfig in src/config/types.rs has `server` and other orchestration fields, but no `web` field; main.rs creates web::WebConfig from CLI args instead of project config.
